title: BeyondNetherite
description: Beyond Netherite expands Minecraft’s endgame progression by adding Purpurit, a powerful new material beyond Netherite. Search the End for Purpurit Ore, process the new resources, and upgrade your Netherite gear into stronger Purpurit equipment.
body:
# **Beyond Netherite** 
**Beyond Netherite** introduces a new endgame expansion to Minecraft.
The mod adds a new material called **_Purpurite_**, which serves as an evolution of Netherite, offering players further goals beyond the standard Netherite progression.
You can find **_Purpurite End Ore_** in the End dimension and use it to create new materials. These can be used to craft powerful **_Purpurite tools_**, **_weapons_**, and **_armor_**, or to upgrade existing Netherite gear.
Additionally, the mod includes new blocks—such as the **_Smelter Workbench_** and the **_Smasher Block_**—used to process these new materials. In doing so, **Beyond Netherite** expands not only the available equipment but also the crafting and progression paths in the late game.

## **Features:**
1. New material: Purpurite
2. New ore in the End: Purpurite End Ore
3. ### **Purpurite tools:**
    > Sword
    > Axe
    > Pickaxe
    > Shovel
    > Hoe
    > Spear
4. ### **Purpurite armor:**
    > Helmet
    > Chestplate
    > Leggings
    > Boots
5. ### Additional armor:
    > Purpurite Horse Armor
    > Purpurite Nautilus Armor
6. ### **New Purpurite block**
7. ### **New crafting/processing blocks:**
    > Smelter Workbench
    > Smasher Block
8. ### **Others**
    > Netherite gear can be upgraded to Purpurite gear
    > Dedicated Creative tab for all mod content
    > New recipes and endgame progression
